Whether my job is halal or haram 5327 views Q. income 1759 views Q. Can People tell Lie for going to Jamat 2367 views Q. How to spend interest money 2180 views Q. Kindly guide if one can sell things which he has traded verbally only. Suppose, Asif agreed a price with Irfan of a book for Ruppees 10 & then later on Asif sells the same book to Salem for Ruppes 12. Is this transaction is Halal. And what is rule for down payement (Bayana) as this is very common practise in our society. People pay a small amount, supporse 10% of original price of the thing & then sell it onwards. Is this practise is Halal. Kindly guide. 1584 views Q. I am a PhD Student in a reputed research institute from India. The sole niyyat of my doing PhD is daawat/tashkeel/kasb-e-halaal in the institute. Once in 6 months I need to go in a conference and present a paper in a conference hall or auditorium. I have a beard with fist length and I am always in long loose kurta and shalwar above ankles. When I am on the stage, the photographers treat me similar to all the audience and take a photo/video of mine or they take my photo whenever I ask questions during the discussion. They do this for non-muslims too. I totally dislike that someone take my photo, because thats haraam as per my knowledge. So my respected muftyaan-e-ikraam is it permissible for a practising muslim to wear a thin helmet (with face cover) and goto such places? If the audience laugh seeing a practising Muslim in helmet, is then wearing the helmet permissible in shariat? I feel my niyaat of daawat/tashkeel and my muaamlaat demand that I should go there but shariat prohibits photography so how shall I maintain taqwa in this issue? Is the question clear ? Hoping for an earliest reply. 2390 views Q. Use of online payments from bank Apps or third party payments Apps 18872 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 38845 Country: India Title: Somebody said it is haram to ride on elephants. Please elaborate the answer Question: Somebody said it is haram to ride on elephants. Please elaborate the answer. Answer ID: 38845 Posted on: May 15, 2023 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1250/756/L=1433) It is lawful and halal to ride elephant. It is not haram. Whoever said that riding elephant is haram he is wrong. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
